title: Sunday · the beach in October, the pup
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The pup at five on the October beach, the light low, the drift log. A dog Sunday; the strip allows one a year.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach in low October light, long shadows, the pup running the tideline at full scuttle, his shadow three-legged and enormous.
